subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: Should maintainers accept this PR as a scoped embedded-runtime `sessions_spawn` mitigation while keeping the broader fallback completion-announcement invariant open for gateway, `sessions_send`/cron, and Codex-native spawn follow-ups?
rationale: The patch appears correct for one important embedded choke point, but repository policy treats fallback/session behavior and one-sided harness fixes as compatibility-sensitive, and the PR intentionally leaves other delegation surfaces unguarded.

options.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
options.body: Merge after branch refresh with the linked issue left open for the remaining work-spawning surfaces.

options.title: Require Common Policy Seam First
options.body: Hold the PR until fallback+announcement context is available to every work-delegating surface in one owner-approved design.

options.title: Pause Partial Gate
options.body: Close or pause this branch if maintainers do not want fail-closed `sessions_spawn` behavior before the complete invariant is designed.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
recommendation.body: Merge after branch refresh with the linked issue left open for the remaining work-spawning surfaces.
